findings.description: If `.pupitre/project.yml` is not valid YAML (e.g. `skipTestsOnUntestedChanges: [false`), `parse` throws its own error, which gives only a line and column and never names the file. The reader's other errors all start with `Invalid .pupitre/project.yml: ...`, so this one should too: wrap `parse` and rethrow with that prefix.

`PROJECT_CONFIG_PATH` (a path fragment) and `SKIP_UNTESTED_KEY` are defined in the `.config.ts` file. docs/conventions/general.md says path fragments belong in the area's `*.constants.ts`, and the sibling `.pupitre/adapter.yml` path already lives in `src/adapters/custom-adapter.constants.ts`.

process_issues.description: The first review-correctness and review-security spawns (opus) ended at once with an API 403 authentication_failed error (Cloudflare 'Attention Required'). I re-spawned both once and both returned full reports. The failed first attempts are listed in reviewers_spawned but not in reviewers_returned.

I dropped review-simplicity's one nit (drop the unknown-key check in project-config.config.ts). The reviewer's own report said the code comment gives a real reason for the check, so the nit named no cost that outweighs it.
Inside one Bash call, `gh pr diff 316 -- <paths>` was refused. The reviewer used the scoped `git diff <merge_base>..HEAD` instead. Its coverage was not affected.
